metadata.description: Condition C2: same narrow QE-span localization as conditions B/D from the prior B/D/C1 comparison (gen_art_experiment_3, iter_2), but the repaired span is iteratively re-verified by the 4-category content-invariant checker and re-repaired with a TARGETED prompt (up to MAX_PASSES=3), stopping on a certificate. Isolates whether iteration ALONE (no checker-broadened localization, unlike C1) closes C1's gap over B/D.

cost_estimate_presweep.decision: Projected worst-case $0.0956 is within sub-budget $2.00; proceeding with the full sweep at MAX_PASSES=3, all eligible rows, no reduction needed.

cegis_narrowing_signal.interpretation: A row 'narrows' if its LAST pass's edit distance from the prior-pass sentence is <= its FIRST pass's edit distance (a weak proxy for convergence toward a stable repair, since exact span boundaries drift as the whole sentence is rewritten each pass). This is descriptive, not a claim of formal CEGIS convergence -- see multi_pass_trends for the raw per-row sequences.

C2.note: C2's n_injected_scored excludes structural non-attempts (negation_polarity_flip deletions), n=60 -- B/D/C1's n_injected_scored (240) includes those rows with fixed=False by construction (see B/D/C1's own injected_pool_localization_protocol_caveat), so a raw fix_rate comparison against B/D is slightly conservative for B/D (their denominator is larger) -- reported as-is, not adjusted, and this note documents the asymmetry rather than silently normalizing it away.

comparison_table_B_D_C1_vs_C2.success_criterion_b_note: Success criterion (b) asks whether C2 vs C1 improves regression rate and whether C2 improves DeltaCOMET over D. Read true_regression_rate_pooled and delta_comet_mean directly off this table for C1/D/C2.

metadata.checker_verdict_definitions: injected-pool rows: checker_verdict.passed = fixed (corrupted_span string absent from the candidate sentence) AND NOT true_regression (no new invariant loss vs the pre-repair hypothesis, per checker.detect_all on metadata_clean_target_text) -- the SAME ground-truth definitions B/D/C1 used to compute fix_rate/true_regression_rate, reused rather than reinvented so the per-pass certificate and the headline metric cannot silently disagree. natural rows: checker_verdict.passed = checker.detect_all() (non-excluded cells only) returns zero flags overlapping the edited span's character range -- mirrors what C1 already computes in a single pass; C2 iterates it with a targeted re-repair prompt naming the still-flagged category/text.
metadata.negation_deletion_limitation: negation_polarity_flip corruptions in the injected pool are DELETIONS (the target-language negation marker was removed, metadata_corrupted_span==''), so there is no contiguous substring to mask or target -- C2 (like B/D before it) marks these rows c2_attempted=False, skip_reason='negation_deletion_zero_width_span', and reports them as 'N/A (structural non-attempt)' in the per-category table rather than folding them into a misleading 0% fix rate. They remain in n_rows denominators throughout.
limitations_not_verified_identical_to_pr: none -- row-ID identity to the prior B/D/C1 run was fully verified

[en-ru_RU] You can get a folding leaf table, and if you saw off the bottom 15cm or so of the panels forming the sides and front of the table, and also don't bother to attach any of the the back leaf, then it becomes just the right height to mostly fit under the rear window.
It's a little higher than the camper-fridge, but the camper fridge is pretty much the same height as a little bedside cabinet.
There's also a small rectangular sink that fits nicely around the same width as the fridge alongside that cut down table.
And thus, the interior can be mostly constructed in my flat. The kids in the flat upstairs kept waving as me as I was doing a terrible job of cutting down those panels with a jigsaw in the yard.
examples.output:
Можно приобрести складной стол, и если отпилить нижние 15 см или около того панелей, образующих бока и переднюю часть стола, а также не заморачиваться с креплением задней части, то он станет ровно такой высоты, чтобы в основном поместиться под задним окном.
Он немного выше, чем автодом-холодильник, но холодильник автодома примерно такой же высоты, как маленький прикроватный шкаф.
Там также есть небольшая прямоугольная раковина, которая хорошо вписывается в ту же ширину, что и холодильник, рядом с укороченным столом.
И таким образом, интерьер можно в основном собрать в моей квартире. Дети в квартире наверху постоянно махали мне рукой, когда я делал ужасную работу по резке этих панелей электролобзиком во дворе.

examples.input: [en-ru_RU/named_entity_swap] Thus, we had the introduction of the Cost of Living (Tenant protection) (Scotland) Act 2022 nearly 18 months ago which sought to cap rents for a limited period to ease the pressures of the cost-of-living crisis. What we find now from the latest Scottish Government statistics is that, in the last year alone, average rents have increased in all sized properties, ranging from the lowest rise of 11.7 per cent for one-bedroom to the highest figure of 14.3 per cent for two-bedroom homes. Every type of property (from one to four bedroom to a room in a property) has had a double digit increase in rents since the Cost of Living legislation was introduced in October 2022, exceeding the annual average increases in rents over the previous 12 years by a factor of at least three.
examples.output: Так, почти 18 месяцев назад был принят закон о прожиточном минимуме (защите арендатора) (Швеции) от 2022 года, который должен был временно остановить рост цен на аренду жилья, чтобы снизить давление финансового кризиса. На данный момент из актуальной государственной статистики Шотландии становится ясно, что даже за прошедший год средняя стоимость аренды недвижимости любого размера выросла. Рост составил от 11,7 процентов за квартиры с одной спальней до 14,3 процента за дома с двумя спальнями. Цены аренды всех видов недвижимости (квартир от одной до четырех спален, а также комнат в коммунальных квартирах) выросли на двузначные числа после принятия указа о прожиточном минимуме в октябре 2022 года, при этом ежегодный рост цен на аренду за последние 12 лет был превышен как минимум втрое.
